text:
kevin: Marigold CS — customer reported sharp p99 spike for chat completions (prod region us-west-2) starting ~11:18 UTC. Thousands of requests, p95 ~600ms but p99 jumped to 8-12s and some 504s. They provided logs and request ids. Can oncall pick up?

ops-bot: alert: tenant=marigold p99=11.2s p95=0.62s error_rate=0.8% incident_id=INC-1223

samir: oncall here, looking. What model/route? reserved? any change in traffic pattern?

kevin: route: `completions-v1` model `vicuna-13b-q8` via hosted API, tenant not on reservation. Traffic pattern: batch jobs started at 11:15, high concurrency from a campaign, avg tokens per req ~800.

jordana: possible noisy neighbor from embeddings or big batch. Checking queue depth and GPU utilization now.

samir: looking at runtime metrics: queue_depth spikes coincide with p99. active_workers saturated on node pool gpu-pool-3. Some GPUs show high host CPU steal (15%) and io_wait. Also seeing increased KV cache miss rate for that tenant's session keys.

maya: can we add temporary throttling or priority lane? Marigold is a paying enterprise, need quick mitigation.

samir: immediate mitigations: 1) add to soft-priority lane 2) create ephemeral reservation for 2h 3) enable fallback to `vicuna-7b` for overflow. I'll run commands.

samir: running: ```bash
rbctl reservation create --tenant marigold --pool reserved-short --duration 2h --reason "p99 spike mitigation"
rbctl route update --tenant marigold --fallback-model vicuna-7b
``` 

ops-bot: reservation created id=resv-8742, routed fallback applied

jordana: pushed a quick per-tenant QPS cap `qps:50` to reduce queue buildup; also evicted large KV prefixes from cache for marigold to free memory. Monitoring CPU steal mitigation.

kevin: CS confirmed latency improved for some users, p99 down to ~1.1s after reservation and cap. They asked for a postmortem and permanent solution.

samir: next steps: - keep reservation for 2h, observe. - collect sample requests (kevin pls ask customer to share 3 representative requests) - eng-runtime to investigate KV cache churn and if we can hard-isolate hot prefixes. I'll open an eng ticket.

maya: noted. @kevin collect sample requests and any user ids. Also include any client-side retry/backoff behavior. :thumbsup:

samir: created ENG-2895: investigate cache hotset and scheduler fairness. tagging jordana and runtime team. Will update in 1h.

kevin: thx team — will follow up with customer and post samples here.
